newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SERVGRO TO LIST AVIS CAR RENTAL UNIT ON JSE.
newsitem.headline: SERVGRO TO LIST AVIS CAR RENTAL UNIT ON JSE.

text.p: South African group Servgro Ltd said on Monday that it planned to list its Avis car rental unit on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.
"The mechanism and timing of the listing are still to be finalised," the firm said in a statement.
The firm is the largest Avis licensee outside the United States and to the year ended March, 1996, posted a net profit of 35 million rand on a turnover of 308 million rand.
Its two main operations are Avis Rent-A-Car, which has 39 percent of the South African market, and Avis Fleet Services, a full maintenance leasing operation.

The unit also has interests all over the Southern African region. It owns Avis operations in Botswana, Namibia and Swaziland and manages Avis sub-licensees in Angola, Lesotho, Madagascar, Malawi, Mozambique, Zambia and Zimbabwe.
